changes: No substantive changes to persons, date or place.
Notes expanded: the epithet kūrmācalākhaṇḍaladvāragīrvāṇaguru, the 'gīvāṇa' spelling, the era assumption, and the fact that the colophon covers only the first dhārā.

notes: The author's epithet 'kūrmācalākhaṇḍaladvāragīvāṇaguru' (read gīrvāṇa-, the MS has 'gīvāṇa') most likely means 'Sanskrit preceptor at the court (dvāra) of the lord (ākhaṇḍala) of Kūrmācala (Kumaon)'. On that reading Premanidhi is a Kumaoni court paṇḍita, and Kūrmācala is his place of service rather than strictly his residence. The colophon names no era. 'saṃvat 1882' is taken as VS (≈1825 CE) because the copy was made in Kāśī. The catalogue gives King Śrīpṛthvīpati Sāha Deva, but he does not appear in this colophon excerpt, so he is not recorded here. He may come from elsewhere in the MS or be a cataloguing error. The colophon closes only the first dhārā (prathamadhārā) of the Kumāraśakti.
